# Round Funded

> Round Funded matches founders to investors from a 60,000+ investor database and provides a fundraising data room. Fundraising is super easy.

Product / investor match: https://roundfunded.com/en/tools/investor-match
GitHub profile: https://github.com/roundfunded
SAFE checklist gist: https://gist.github.com/roundfunded/61ad335514f2b04b1c30d03034bad245

## Facts

- Brand: Round Funded
- Investor coverage: 60,000+
- Product: investor matching + fundraising data room
- Investor types: angels and VCs
- Stages: pre-seed to Series C
- Coverage: 40 industries, 60 countries
- Filters: stage, industry, country
- Audience: founders raising pre-seed through Series C
- Not an accelerator
- Not a fund
- No YC / Antler / Techstars / 500 partnership claims
- No pricing on this page

Last updated: 2026-08-14
